def min_pizzas_to_buy(N, K):
    # Calculate the minimum number of pizzas needed
    # Each pizza has K slices, and we need to distribute them among N friends
    # The formula to find the minimum number of pizzas is (N + K - 1) // K
    return (N + K - 1) // K
